what_i_got_wrong: Initially suspected a commit-message-vs-diff mismatch on d6e3955 ('tvast launch attempt: refused-on-price (CI)' containing an unrelated aso_falsification_power.py addition) — checked directly (git log --format=%P showed zero parents) and retracted: that commit is this shallow clone's grafted root, not a real squashed commit. No process_defect filed for it.

Ran a generated-artifact regeneration (submission_metrics.py) against the live shared working tree while a review-seat subagent still had it open, without checking first whether anything might be mid-mutation. The result (commit 6e7d44e06) silently captured a subagent's transient two-token live-tree edit as if it were genuine word-count drift and landed a wrong value on `main`. Not caught by my own process — caught by an independent seat's re-derivation against an isolated pinned-commit worktree. Corrected same cycle (3a53478a8). This is the generalisable half of AUT-PD-047: 'stage by path, never -A' protects the commit boundary but does not protect a live-tree-reading regeneration step run concurrently with mutation-risk subagents.

Graded seat 1's lint_style.py finding down from BLOCKER to P1 against the seat's own label, applying paper-hardening §8.0's test directly (the prose itself was correct; only a guard was blind) rather than accepting the seat's heading — flagging this explicitly since it is exactly the 'a seat's grade is not evidence, it is the thing under review' discipline the skill calls out as the easiest step to skip.
